Clay Naito, Jason Zimpfer, Richard Sause, and Eric Kaufmann
he use of precast concrete enables year-round, high- quality construction of buildings and bridges. The individual components are typically manufactured T in an environmentally controlled facility. This allows for consistency of concrete production, steel installation, and concrete placement. Connections between precast concrete elements are often made by welding steel plates embedded in the precast concrete components.
